items.title: Bold Abstract Shard Geometric Panel Pattern for Plasma and CNC
items.description: Make a strong architectural statement with this bold, minimalist abstract shard pattern, composed of sharp irregular lines and striking negative spaces. Carefully optimized in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this heavy-duty template is specifically engineered for flawless execution on CNC plasma cutters and thick MDF wood routers, making it the perfect option for security entrance doors, industrial-style privacy fences, and modern external gates.
